breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the error from the incomplete prompt by replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated load at the free end and using δ = WL/(AE). The ground truth requires integrating the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρgA(L−x) using δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(AE) dx, which yields δ = ρgL²/(2E). The agent's approach produces a result (≈0.01367 mm) that is exactly twice the correct answer (≈0.00684 mm), confirming the inconsistency was not resolved.
